question: In which state/UT, in October 2021, a measure to reduce crime in the society 'Operation Sajag' was launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __Delhi__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• 'Operation Sajag' was launched to prevent incidents of street crime in Delhi .
 
• To curb incidents of street crime, the North West District Police launched Operation Sajag on 4 October.
 
• Police said the initiative includes field-dominated exercises, special searches and in-depth checks on pickets.
 
• The North West District Delhi Police initiated it. The initiative includes area domination exercises, intensive checks on pickets and special searches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
